origin: claude.ai web renderer hosted in the Desktop webview; event names are absent from the local Electron .vite chunks, so contracts are pinned on every captured occurrence (field names, key order, value types, non-identifying constants; values are never copied)

events.condition: renderer navigates to /epitaxy/<sessionId> when a new local session opens (analytics.js page call; the id segment is redacted by the renderer itself)
events.lifecycle_position: first call of the session-open batch: before claudeai.desktop.code.landing.session_created, claudeai.epitaxy.session.opened and claudeai.epitaxy.session.meta_resolved

events.condition: renderer session view mounted for a new local session
events.lifecycle_position: after the /epitaxy/:redacted page call and claudeai.desktop.code.landing.session_created; before claudeai.epitaxy.session.meta_resolved

events.condition: renderer resolved the session metadata of a new local session
events.lifecycle_position: immediately after claudeai.epitaxy.session.opened; before claudeai.code.session.first_text / ttft

events.condition: Desktop event-logging copy of the /epitaxy (activation) and /epitaxy/:redacted (session open) page calls; emitted only after the Segment page call was persisted, so _dual_fire is true (the 5/54 captured shell copies with _dual_fire false have no Segment twin and are not reproduced)
events.lifecycle_position: Desktop copy of a renderer page call, right after the Segment page call of the same route

value_derivation.anonymous_id: Segment anonymousId of the page call

events.condition: renderer shell page call once per application activation (registerRendererActivationHook after the Segment identify)
events.lifecycle_position: renderer shell load, next to the Segment identify of the application activation

events.boundary: shell inventory at activation: total_session_count equals local_session_count in 54/54 occurrences (5..33, never 0), i.e. the persisted sidebar session list of the account; the retention semantics of the gateway per-account session markers were not verified in the time box, so the count has no pinned gateway source; not emitted
has_repo (git repository check of the landing directory) has no gateway source and version differs between captures (2 and 3); not emitted

events.condition: a later prompt-starting main request of a session carries a different PermissionMode than the previous prompt (renderer mode dropdown; change_method mode_dropdown and surface ccd in 7/7 occurrences); Desktop copy path /epitaxy
events.lifecycle_position: between two prompts of a session, before the next claudeai.code.message.submitted

value_derivation.previous_mode: PermissionMode of the previous prompt of the session

events.boundary: reactive renderer watchdog (pending_age_ms about 30000 with meta_is_running true) fired when a pending turn shows no progress; the gateway has no such watchdog; not emitted

events.condition: a visible management Code workbench tick asks the server to scan the exact account registry; the client supplies no counters
events.lifecycle_position: visible Code workbench periodic tick after the owner-scoped session list is available

value_derivation.fresh: measured fresh classification only (zero while no renderer freshness cache exists)
value_derivation.probe_dispatched: records with a validated live Host
value_derivation.recently_checked: measured recent-check classification only (zero while no renderer check cache exists)
value_derivation.unknown: records whose live Host identity cannot be validated

events.boundary: UI click on a sidebar session entry (via click, section recents, sidebar unified); single captured occurrence; nobody clicks in the emulated flow; not emitted

renderer paint/tab measurements (ttfvt_first_text_paint_ms, first_text_receipt_ms, start_to_emit_ms, tab_age_ms, open_local_session_count) vary in every occurrence and are not measurable by the gateway; not emitted
no captured occurrence under either recorder corpus; the key set cannot be pinned; not emitted
no captured occurrence under either recorder corpus; the key set cannot be pinned; not emitted
